From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-09-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP Sprint: Dedicated GPU Pool — kickoff & staging plan

Hi Alicia + Nimbus CloudOps team,

Thanks for taking the time earlier this week. Per our conversation, attached is a starter Mutual Action Plan and a lightweight evaluation plan so we can get to a short, executable sprint that validates throughput and latency targets on a reserved GPU pool. High-level goals I suggest for the kickoff: 

- Target steady-state throughput: ~800 seq/s (512 token window)
- Latency SLO: p95 < 120ms for generation with caching enabled
- Trial window: 2 weeks of traffic replay + 3 days of production-like canary
- Acceptance criteria: throughput, p95 latency, and no regression on quality evals

I’ve attached: Redwood_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx and evaluation_plan_outline.md.

Primary asks from Nimbus for the kickoff: 
1) Confirm stakeholder owners (tech, infra, procurement)
2) Procurement timing / PO cadence (so we can plan Dedicated capacity reservations)
3) Any networking/VPC/VPN constraints for Private Dedicated setup

Proposed initial milestones (draft):
- 09/10: Agree on stakeholders and final MAP milestones
- 09/14: Reserve GPU pool and provision network access
- 09/21: Begin trial (replay + synthetic load)
- 10/05: Acceptance review and production canary

Would like to schedule a 30–45m kickoff next week to align on owners and the procurement path. Calendars attached as a tentative invite.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
[karthik.iyer@redwood.ai]

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), evaluation_plan_outline.md (text)

Looping internal owners on what Karthik and Alicia outlined. Suggested responsibilities and technical acceptance criteria below so we come into the call with a clear RACI: 

- Rishi (technical lead): own benchmark harness, run replay, verify p95 latency and tail behavior, collect traces
- Marissa (e2e eval lead): own quality evals, prompt sets, and regression checks against baseline
- Vanessa (infra liaison): own GPU pool sizing, autoscaling policy, and VPC setup with Nimbus CloudOps
- Priyom (program manager): own MAP timeline, drive follow-ups, and track procurement milestones

Proposed technical targets we should program into the evaluation plan: 
- Steady replay throughput: 800 seq/s (512 tokens) sustained for 60 minutes
- Spike tolerance: handle 2x burst for 10 minutes without queue drop
- Latency: p50 < 45ms, p95 < 120ms (generation path, no tool calls)
- Cost estimate: rough per-1M token cost using quantized runtime (we’ll add numbers after first bench)

I added a short link to the shared drive with the benchmark harness and a template runbook: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAP-nimbus-dedicated
